service.description: A work order's parts (MAINTENANCE_VIEW, or the assigned technician's MAINTENANCE_ASSIGNED_VIEW; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, NOT_ASSIGNED): its planned lines with their step, quantity, unit, required date and source facility, and what was issued, returned, used and is left of each; the issues and the returns once each (a step's are not added again at the root), the parts used net of returns, the equipment model's spare parts not yet planned (for a planner or supervisor), and what the caller may do. With withStock the free stock each line may be issued from (the work organization's available inventory in the caller's facilities). Values only with MAINTENANCE_COST_VIEW.

parameter.name: workEffortId
parameter.description: The work order's root, or one of its steps

parameter.name: stepList
parameter.description: The nodes a part may be planned on: value and label

service.description: A planned part of a work order's root or step (MAINTENANCE_PLAN or _SUPERVISE; open work only, WORK_CLOSED): a WorkEffortProduct row (WeptConsume) with its quantity (QUANTITY_INVALID), unit, required date and source facility (one of the work organization's, VALUE_INVALID); a change ends the open row of the product and starts the next, naming the row it read by fromDate (RECORD_CHANGED); remove ends it. A supplies part is refused (SUPPLIES_REFUSED: it would post as a fixed asset, impl-maintenance F71). With addSuggested, the equipment model's spare parts (PatSparePart) not yet planned on the work are added to the node at their association's quantity.

parameter.name: fromDate
parameter.description: The line read, when changing or removing one

service.description: Issue a part to a work order's root or step (design §3 MaterialIssueReceipt Issue; F71): a new AssetIssuance each time through mantle.product.AssetServices.issue#AssetToWorkEffort, carrying the work's cost centre, project and primary AssetMaintenance; it posts to the maintenance expense of AC-24, never to WIP. Requires STOCK_ISSUE (the stock in a facility of the user's organizations, StockPosting.js) and the maintenance grant: the technician assigned to the work or the step (MAINTENANCE_EXECUTE; NOT_ASSIGNED) or a supervisor; approved or started work (WORK_NOT_STARTED). Refuses equipment and supplies (NOT_STOCK, SUPPLIES_REFUSED), another product than the line's (PRODUCT_MISMATCH), held stock (HELD_STOCK), a customer's or another owner's stock (OWNER_MISMATCH), more than is free (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_AVAILABLE), an organization that posts with no maintenance expense mapping (COST_POLICY_MISSING, naming what to map) and a closed period (PERIOD_CLOSED). A retry with the same operation key answers the first.

parameter.name: workEffortId
parameter.description: The root or the step the part is issued to

parameter.name: productId
parameter.description: The planned line's product, checked against the asset's

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode ISSUED, workEffortId, rootWorkEffortId, assetId, productId, lotId, quantity, assetIssuanceId, onHandAfter and the operation fields.

service.description: Return unused parts of an issuance (design §3 MaterialIssueReceipt Return unused; F71): a new AssetReceipt through mantle.product.AssetServices.receive#Asset naming its issuance (sourceAssetIssuanceId), into the original asset where it is or a location of a facility of the same owner, at the original asset's acquireCost; its credit goes to the issuance's expense account and dimensions (AC-24), not to WIP, in one transaction. Never cancels or changes the issuance. Requires STOCK_ISSUE and the assigned technician or a supervisor (NOT_ASSIGNED); refuses closed or cancelled work (WORK_CLOSED), no quantity (QUANTITY_INVALID), more than is left of the issuance (QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_ISSUED), a closed or missing location and a closed period. A retry with the same operation key answers the first.

parameter.name: toLocationSeqId
parameter.description: Empty returns into the original asset

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: resultCode RETURNED, workEffortId, rootWorkEffortId, assetIssuanceId, assetId, intoOriginal, productId, quantity, facilityId, locationSeqId, assetReceiptId and the operation fields.
